source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 16 January 1926, p. 8 ("Municipal elections (continued from page 7)"); Belfast News-Letter, 16 January 1926, p. 7 ("Municipal elections: the new members")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes from the News-Letter's ward results (INA OCR; Court, Pottinger and Woodvale read on the page image); * = retiring member as printed; where the OCR of a vote is garbled the figure used is the one that agrees with both the printed valid votes and the printed majority; unopposed returns from the News-Letter's list of new members (16 January) and account of the nominations (6 January)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation) together with the triennial election of aldermen for Duncairn, Ormeau, Pottinger, Smithfield, St Anne's, St George's and Woodvale; nominations 5 January, poll Friday 15 January 1926. Ten members were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 6 and 16 January 1926).
